description: When the viewer asks for the Page editor ahead of an open. A route that opens a document starts it at boot; a listing route holds it until its first rows paint and the browser is idle, or until a pointer or focus shows intent to open a Page. Runs against viewer/editor-start-machine.mjs in viewer/editor-start.test.mjs.
unreachable: The row watcher attaches at boot
The idle callback is requested only after the rows paint
The intent listeners attach at boot
The idle callback is requested only after the rows paint

rows.label: a listing route holds the editor and watches for rows and intent
a route that opens a document starts the editor at boot
rows.note: /p/<id>, Project content, legacy ?page= links and unknown paths.

rows.label: a holding route reads its route once
the first rows painted: wait for the browser to be idle
intent before the rows paint starts the editor at once
rows.note: A pointer or focus on New Page or the Page switcher while the list loads.

rows.label: a painted route reads its route once
rows that paint again ask for no second idle callback
the browser is idle after the rows painted: start the editor
intent before the idle callback starts the editor at once
rows.note: A pointer entering a row: the stop cancels the pending idle callback.

rows.label: a started editor reads no route
rows painting after the start change nothing
rows.note: A Page route that later shows the library.

expect.rejected: The editor was already asked for

rows.label: a late idle callback asks for nothing

expect.rejected: The editor was already asked for

rows.label: intent after the start asks for nothing
